_doc: Oathwild's regions (owner 2026-11-27: 'new regions, separated by travel points and loading screens … each zone a specific level bracket'; docs/BRAINSTORM-2026-11-27-regions.md §1). A hosted world holds every region; each region is its own map, made by its `kind`'s generator (js/world/regions/), loaded when entered, run as its own room on the server sharing the world's quests and story flags (server/hub.js). `home`: where a new hero starts. `points`: travel points — walk to one and confirm to travel to `to` (a point in another region; you arrive `arrive` metres in front of it, along its `facing` — radians, 0 = +z). `loading`: the loading screen's picture, line and tip. js/world/regions/index.js is the one reader.

loading.line: Farms, mills and old roads between the hills — and the goblins, wolves and bandits who prey on them.
loading.tip: Lantern posts in each town are waypoints: touch one to travel back to it later from the Places list (M).

loading.line: The old cemetery on the hill has not been quiet for a month. The hamlet at the crossing keeps its lanterns lit all night.
loading.tip: Some open graves are worth a look. Some are worth a fight.

loading.line: Below the Mausoleum Hill the dead are laid in halls older than the town — and something has dug in from the deep.
loading.tip: Monsters only notice you when they can see you: walls and pillars hide you.
